The **cancel job capability is already fully implemented** across all three layers. All 24 tests pass.

## What exists today

### API layer (`apps/server/src/routes.ts`)

- **`POST /api/jobs/:id/cancel`** (line 652–667) — cancels any job by ID, marks suite cancelled in store, returns `409` if already finished
- **`POST /api/benchmarks/:id/cancel`** (line 543–555) — cancels by suite ID (finds active job first)

### Job layer (`apps/server/src/jobs.ts`)

- **`JobManager.cancel(id)`** (line 175–192) — sets `cancelRequested = true`; for queued jobs, immediately removes from queue and marks cancelled; for running jobs, the body observes it at the next `ctx.throwIfCancelled()` checkpoint
- **`JobCancelledError`** (line 61–66) — thrown at checkpoints, caught in `execute()` to transition to `"cancelled"` status
- **`ctx.throwIfCancelled()`** (line 265–268) — checks both cancellation flag and wall-clock timeout

### Store layer (`apps/server/src/job-store.ts`)

- **`JobStore.save()`** persists every state transition (including cancelled) to `.codeatlas/benchmarks/jobs/<id>.json`
- Suite status durably written via `BenchmarkStore.updateSuiteStatus(suiteId, "cancelled")`

### Tests (`apps/server/tests/`)

| Test | File | What it verifies |
|---|---|---|
| Cancel queued job | `api.test.ts:506–597` | Queued job removed, never runs, stages set to `"cancelled"` |
| Cancel in-flight job | `api.test.ts:599–697` | Running job observes flag at checkpoint, suite marked `"cancelled"` on disk |
| Cancel already-finished | `api.test.ts:699–767` | Returns `409 not_cancellable`, no state corruption |
| Cancel queued (unit) | `jobs.test.ts:49–66` | JobManager removes from queue, body never called |
| Cancel running (unit) | `jobs.test.ts:68–91` | Cooperative flag observed at `throwIfCancelled()` |
| Reject cancel of finished | `jobs.test.ts:93–105` | Returns `false`, status unchanged |

**All 24 tests pass.** No implementation work is needed — the feature is complete and fully tested.
